resources.string: Check your selected quota at a glance. Saved order, decimal precision, opacity and tap action are retained.
Up to four tasks at the recommended size, or six with more height. Running tasks come first. Requires your paired PC.
Custom dashboards and existing lock screen layouts. Your installed widgets stay available.
Simple quota: single dial or numbers. Comparison: rings or bars. Lock screen and AOD support depends on the Samsung device and host.
These are last confirmed states, not live task results. A command error does not mean the whole task failed. Approval/input waiting is not currently reported by the PC observer.
